domestic.title_zh: 国内电商新手入行指引

details_zh: 准备本人有效期内身份证（年满16周岁）
办理一张本人名下银行卡（建议四大行或股份制银行）
完成支付宝/微信实名认证
如需做企业店，提前注册个体工商户或公司营业执照
details_en: Have a valid government ID (must be 16 or older)
Get a bank card in your own name (a major bank is recommended)
Complete real-name verification for Alipay / WeChat
For a business store, register a sole proprietorship or company license in advance

details_zh: 新手建议从淘宝/拼多多起步（个人即可开店）
有内容能力选抖音/快手电商
确定类目：从自己熟悉或有货源优势的领域入手
查看该类目是否需要特殊资质（如食品经营许可证、化妆品备案等）
details_en: Beginners should start with Taobao or Pinduoduo (individuals can open a store)
Choose Douyin or Kuaishou if you are good at content
Pick a category you know or where you have a supply advantage
Check whether the category needs special qualifications (e.g. food license, cosmetics filing)

details_zh: 下载对应平台卖家APP或访问卖家中心
使用手机号注册账号
提交身份证正反面+人脸识别
缴纳消费者保障保证金（淘宝1000元，可用30元保险替代）
设置店铺名称、Logo、简介
details_en: Download the platform's seller app or visit the seller center
Register with your phone number
Submit the front and back of your ID and complete face verification
Pay the buyer-protection deposit (Taobao 1,000 yuan, or a ~30-yuan insurance alternative)
Set your store name, logo, and description

details_zh: 无货源模式：1688一键代发（新手推荐试水）
一件代发：联系供应商确认代发政策和质量
自采模式：义乌/广州/杭州等批发市场实地采购
小批量试单：先拿样确认质量，再小批量上架
留存采购凭证和供应商联系方式
details_en: No-inventory model: dropship from 1688 (recommended for beginners)
Dropshipping: confirm the supplier's policy and product quality
Self-purchase: buy in person at wholesale markets such as Yiwu, Guangzhou, or Hangzhou
Order small samples first to verify quality, then list in small batches
Keep purchase records and supplier contacts

details_zh: 拍摄清晰主图（白底图+场景图），首图决定点击率
撰写标题：核心词+属性词+长尾词（参考同行高销量标题）
填写详细属性（影响搜索匹配）
设置合理价格（参考同行均价，新店可略低引流）
设置运费模板（偏远地区加价或不发货）
上架10-20个SKU建立店铺基础
details_en: Take clear main images (white background plus lifestyle shots); the first image drives click rate
Write titles: core words + attribute words + long-tail words (study top-selling peers)
Fill in detailed attributes (they affect search matching)
Set a reasonable price (around the peer average; new stores can price slightly lower)
Set shipping templates (add a surcharge for remote regions or exclude them)
List 10-20 SKUs to build a basic store

details_zh: 通知亲友下单（真实发货，不刷单）
参加平台新人扶持活动
设置新店优惠券（满减/无门槛）
优化标题和主图（根据点击率数据调整）
认真回复每一个咨询（客服响应速度影响权重）
details_en: Ask friends and family to place genuine orders (ship real products; never fake orders)
Join the platform's new-seller support programs
Set new-store coupons (spend-and-save or no-threshold)
Optimize titles and main images based on click-rate data
Reply to every inquiry promptly (response speed affects ranking)

details_zh: 免费流量：优化搜索排名（标题、属性、销量、好评率）
内容流量：发布买家秀、小红书种草、短视频
付费流量：直通车/万相台（日预算50-100元起步测试）
活动流量：报名平台天天特卖、类目活动
私域流量：引导买家关注店铺、加入粉丝群
details_en: Free traffic: improve search ranking (titles, attributes, sales, positive-review rate)
Content traffic: post buyer photos, Xiaohongshu posts, and short videos
Paid traffic: start with 50-100 yuan per day to test sponsored ads
Event traffic: sign up for flash sales and category events
Private traffic: encourage buyers to follow the store and join fan groups

details_zh: 分析数据：哪些SKU卖得好，加大推广；滞销品及时清仓
提升复购：设置会员体系、定期上新、老客优惠券
控制成本：谈判供应商降价、优化快递费
合规经营：不刷单、不虚假宣传、及时处理售后
月销稳定后考虑扩大SKU或升级店铺类型
details_en: Analyze data: push best-selling SKUs and clear slow movers
Increase repeat purchases: membership, regular new arrivals, returning-customer coupons
Control costs: negotiate lower supplier prices and optimize shipping fees
Operate compliantly: no fake orders, no false claims, handle after-sales promptly
Once monthly sales stabilize, expand SKUs or upgrade the store type

crossborder.title_zh: 跨境电商新手入行指引

details_zh: 企业营业执照（个体工商户或公司，建议有限公司）
法人身份证正反面
双币信用卡（Visa/Mastercard，用于平台扣费）
跨境收款账户（Payoneer/WorldFirst/万里汇）
启动资金建议2-5万元（含保证金、首批货、物流、广告）
details_en: Business license (sole proprietorship or company; an LLC is recommended)
Front and back of the legal representative's ID
Dual-currency credit card (Visa/Mastercard) for platform charges
Cross-border payment account (Payoneer / WorldFirst)
Recommended starting capital: 20,000-50,000 yuan (deposit, first inventory, shipping, ads)

details_zh: 新手推荐：Shopee（门槛低、免前3月佣金）或TikTok Shop（流量红利）
有一定资金和经验：Amazon（利润高、规则严）
有技术和营销能力：Shopify独立站
研究目标市场：语言、消费习惯、节日、物流时效要求
查看目标站点的禁止销售品类和认证要求
details_en: Recommended for beginners: Shopee (low barrier, no commission for the first 3 months) or TikTok Shop (traffic growth)
With some capital and experience: Amazon (higher profit, strict rules)
With technical and marketing skills: a Shopify standalone store
Study the target market: language, shopping habits, holidays, delivery expectations
Check prohibited categories and certification requirements for the target site

details_zh: 访问对应平台跨境卖家注册页面
提交营业执照、法人身份证、信用卡信息
完成视频验证或电话验证
缴纳站点保证金（Shopee免、Amazon$39.99/月、TikTok $500-2000）
绑定跨境收款账户
设置店铺信息（英文/当地语言）
details_en: Visit the platform's cross-border seller registration page
Submit your business license, legal rep ID, and credit card details
Complete video or phone verification
Pay the site deposit (Shopee free, Amazon $39.99/month, TikTok $500-2,000)
Link your cross-border payment account
Set up store information in English or the local language

details_zh: 使用平台数据分析工具（卖家精灵/JS/平台前台数据）
选择轻小件（物流成本低）、非易碎、非季节性产品
避开品牌垄断品类（如手机配件）和强认证品类（如电子产品带CE/FCC）
1688采购或义乌市场拿货
小批量试发（50-100件测试市场反应）
确认产品在目标市场无侵权风险（商标/专利查询）
details_en: Use platform analytics tools (SellerSprite / Helium 10 / front-end data)
Choose light, small, non-fragile, non-seasonal products (lower shipping cost)
Avoid brand-dominated categories (e.g. phone accessories) and certification-heavy ones (CE/FCC)
Source from 1688 or the Yiwu market
Test with a small batch (50-100 units) to gauge market response
Confirm no trademark or patent infringement risk in the target market

details_zh: 产品图片：白底主图+场景图+细节图+尺寸图（至少6张）
标题：核心关键词前置，包含品牌名+产品名+核心属性
描述：英文撰写，突出卖点，符合当地语言习惯
定价：计算 landed cost（产品+头程+平台费+广告+退款）后定价
设置库存数量（初期不要设太多）
选择物流方式：自发货或平台仓（FBA/SFP等）
details_en: Images: white-background main image plus lifestyle, detail, and size images (at least 6)
Title: lead with core keywords, including brand, product name, and key attributes
Description: write in natural English (or the local language), emphasizing benefits
Price: calculate landed cost (product + first-mile + platform fees + ads + refunds) first
Set modest inventory levels at the start
Choose a fulfillment method: self-ship or a platform warehouse (FBA/SFP)

details_zh: 自发货：对接专线物流（云途/燕文/4PX），7-15天送达
平台仓：批量发货至海外仓，2-5天送达，转化率更高
打印面单：按平台要求格式打印
及时上传追踪号（延迟会影响店铺绩效）
监控物流异常，及时处理丢件/破损
details_en: Self-fulfillment: use dedicated line logistics (YunTu / YanWen / 4PX), delivery in 7-15 days
Platform warehouse: ship in bulk to an overseas warehouse, delivery in 2-5 days with higher conversion
Print shipping labels in the platform's required format
Upload tracking numbers promptly (delays hurt account performance)
Monitor shipping exceptions and handle lost or damaged packages

details_zh: 平台站内广告：SP广告/展示广告（日预算$10-20起步）
站外引流：Deal站点（Slickdeals/Dealmoon）、社交媒体
Request Review：对已签收订单请求评价
监控转化率和ACOS，优化关键词出价
分析竞品价格和评论，调整自身Listing
details_en: On-site ads: Sponsored Products or display ads (start with $10-20 per day)
Off-site traffic: deal sites (Slickdeals / DealMoon) and social media
Use Request a Review for delivered orders
Monitor conversion rate and ACOS, and optimize keyword bids
Analyze competitor prices and reviews to refine your listing

details_zh: 跑通单品类后，扩展相关品类（关联销售）
优化供应链：谈更低采购价、拼柜发货降低头程
品牌备案：注册商标进行品牌备案，保护Listing
合规经营：不刷评、不侵权、不虚假宣传、及时处理A-to-Z索赔
关注平台政策变化（每月查看卖家中心通知）
盈利后考虑多站点扩张或多平台布局
details_en: After one category works, expand into related products (cross-selling)
Optimize the supply chain: negotiate lower prices and consolidate shipments to cut first-mile cost
Register your trademark and complete brand registry to protect listings
Operate compliantly: no fake reviews, no infringement, no false claims, handle A-to-Z claims promptly
Watch policy changes (check seller-center notices every month)
Once profitable, expand to more sites or platforms

entity_types.intro_zh: 开店前先确定经营主体，不同主体在证照、店铺类型、发票税务和可入驻平台上存在差异。
entity_types.intro_en: Choose your business entity before opening a store; entities differ in documents, store types, invoicing and tax, and eligible platforms.

types.docs_zh: 本人身份证、本人银行卡、支付宝或微信实名认证，无需营业执照
types.docs_en: Your own ID, a bank card in your name, and verified Alipay or WeChat; no business license needed
types.stores_zh: 可开个人店，不能开天猫、京东自营等企业或品牌店铺
types.stores_en: Can open an individual store, but not business or brand stores such as Tmall or JD self-operated
types.tax_zh: 以个人身份经营，通常不能自行开具增值税发票，可按规定申请代开，按个人经营所得申报
types.tax_en: Operates as a person, generally cannot issue VAT invoices directly and applies for issued-on-request invoices; reports personal business income
types.platforms_zh: 淘宝、拼多多等支持个人开店的国内平台；多数跨境平台要求企业资质
types.platforms_en: Domestic platforms that allow individuals, such as Taobao and Pinduoduo; most cross-border platforms require a business entity
types.deposit_zh: 缴纳消费者保障保证金（如淘宝1000元，可用约30元保险替代），部分企业店活动无法参加
types.deposit_en: Pays the buyer-protection deposit (e.g. Taobao 1,000 yuan or a ~30-yuan insurance alternative); some business-store programs are unavailable
types.fit_zh: 适合兼职试水、小规模起步
types.fit_en: Best for part-time trials and small-scale starts

types.docs_zh: 个体工商户营业执照、经营者身份证、经营者银行卡或对公账户
types.docs_en: A sole-proprietorship business license, the operator's ID, and the operator's bank card or a business account
types.stores_zh: 可开企业店或个体店，部分类目可入驻天猫、京东及抖音、快手企业店
types.stores_en: Can open a business or sole-proprietor store; some categories allow Tmall, JD, Douyin or Kuaishou business stores
types.tax_zh: 可申领发票，作为小规模纳税人开具增值税普通发票或申请代开专用发票，按经营所得纳税并可享小规模纳税人优惠
types.tax_en: Can obtain invoices and, as a small-scale taxpayer, issue ordinary VAT invoices or request special ones; pays business income tax and may use small-scale taxpayer benefits
types.platforms_zh: 国内主流平台基本可入驻，多数跨境平台接受（如 Shopee、TikTok Shop、速卖通）
types.platforms_en: Eligible for most domestic platforms and accepted by many cross-border platforms such as Shopee, TikTok Shop and AliExpress
types.deposit_zh: 按企业店标准缴纳，部分类目与个人店存在差异
types.deposit_en: Pays according to business-store standards; some categories differ from individual stores
types.fit_zh: 适合正式经营、有稳定订单、需要开票的卖家
types.fit_en: Best for sellers running a real business with steady orders who need to issue invoices

types.docs_zh: 公司营业执照、法定代表人身份证、对公银行账户并完成税务登记
types.docs_en: A company business license, the legal representative's ID, a corporate bank account and completed tax registration
types.stores_zh: 可开企业店、旗舰店或专卖店（需自有商标或品牌授权），可入驻天猫、京东等
types.stores_en: Can open business, flagship or specialty stores (with a trademark or brand authorization), including Tmall and JD
types.tax_zh: 可登记为一般纳税人或小规模纳税人，可开具增值税专用发票、抵扣进项，按企业纳税申报
types.tax_en: Can register as a general or small-scale taxpayer, issue special VAT invoices, deduct input tax and file corporate tax
types.platforms_zh: 国内主流平台与跨境主流平台均可入驻（如 Amazon、Shopee、TikTok Shop、Shopify、eBay）
types.platforms_en: Eligible for major domestic and cross-border platforms such as Amazon, Shopee, TikTok Shop, Shopify and eBay
types.deposit_zh: 按平台与类目缴纳，天猫、品牌旗舰店等保证金通常更高
types.deposit_en: Pays according to platform and category; Tmall and flagship stores usually require higher deposits
types.fit_zh: 适合规模化、品牌化、团队化经营
types.fit_en: Best for scaled, brand-focused, team-based operations

types.docs_zh: 通常登记为个体工商户或个人独资企业，取得相应营业执照与经营者身份证
types.docs_en: Usually registered as a sole proprietorship or individual-funded enterprise, with the matching license and the operator's ID
types.stores_zh: 店铺类型与个体工商户一致；多账号、多店铺运营须符合平台账号规则
types.stores_en: Store types match a sole proprietorship; running multiple accounts or stores must follow platform account rules
types.tax_zh: 按个体工商户或个人独资企业的经营所得纳税并申领发票
types.tax_en: Pays business income tax and obtains invoices as a sole proprietorship or individual-funded enterprise
types.platforms_zh: 以抖音、快手、小红书等内容电商，以及代运营、内容服务为主
types.platforms_en: Focuses on content commerce such as Douyin, Kuaishou and Xiaohongshu, plus managed operations and content services
types.deposit_zh: 与个体工商户一致，具体以入驻平台与类目为准
types.deposit_en: Same as a sole proprietorship, subject to the platform and category
types.fit_zh: 适合内容创作、直播、代运营等小团队
types.fit_en: Best for small teams doing content creation, live streaming or managed operations

items_zh: 盲目铺货不做选品分析，导致大量滞销
定价只算产品成本，忘了平台佣金、广告费、退款损失
图片质量差，主图不清晰，点击率极低
一开始就大量备货，资金链断裂
不研究平台规则，违规被扣分/封店
刷单/刷评，被平台检测后封店
忽视售后，差评累积影响排名
items_en: Listing hundreds of products without research, leaving large amounts of dead stock
Pricing only against product cost and forgetting platform fees, ads, and refund losses
Poor, unclear main images that lead to very low click rates
Stocking heavily at the start and running out of cash
Not studying platform rules, leading to penalties or store closure
Slow customer service that loses orders
Faking orders or reviews, which leads to a ban once detected
Ignoring after-sales, letting negative reviews build up and hurt ranking
